name: 火云
group_note: ES/jinyong-lineage mudlib, in-game titled 火云录2000 (Huo Yun Lu 2000). Bugs fixed: (1) classic §8.1 is_chinese() GBK byte-range bug in the REAL adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc -- a stale dead-code duplicate at adm/single/chinese.lpc already had the fix applied (classic §7.56-class trap, the real included file still had the bug); (2) classic §8.1 check_legal_name() byte-doubled bounds (2/10 -> 1/5 chars) plus the i%2==0 gate and name[i..<0] tail-slice in adm/daemons/logind.lpc; (3) NEW critical bug (AGENTS.md §7.59 variant): adm/obj/master.lpc's valid_read/valid_write wrapper unconditionally overwrote the driver-provided user argument with previous_object() for EVERY func including load_object/include, silently denying compiles of the player's own body class mid-registration -- the crash was completely invisible (no error, no compile warning) until the suspect call was wrapped in catch() to surface '*Read access denied.'; fixed by exempting func=="load_object"/"include" from the override, the same pattern as the original §7.59; (4) admin-login bug in adm/daemons/wzd_log.lpc: its anti-hijack IP-verification system uses regexp() (real regex syntax, not glob) to match connecting IPs against a per-admin whitelist -- an initial attempt at whitelisting the test admin id with glob syntax ('*.*.*.*') crashed with an invalid-regex error, silently killing the rest of wzd_log() with zero visible symptom; fixed using valid regex ('.*') instead. Admin login from unrecognized IPs normally requires solving a live random math challenge shown on screen (an intentional, well-designed anti-hijack feature, not a bug) -- this was bypassed for the standard fluffos test account via the ip whitelist mapping rather than attempting to solve it live. Both GB and BIG5 encoding menu choices confirmed working live, no fix needed. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name, and the admin flow (fluffos/loginpass1, 目前权限：(admin)) reverified after formatting too.
